body: I knew I should have been more careful about locking doors. Maybe it was the excitement of having everything ready for our project that day made me lose track. As I slowly approach the broken door, my heart races at the thought of confronting whoever opened it without permission. But then, there’s an overwhelming feeling of concern; perhaps they’ve had a bad day or needed help too. So, instead of anger, I take a deep breath and step back, considering if staying close could provide the best solution.
